requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2); a collective agreement, also of the company, that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails, and the bundle holds none.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.
Verify the value on its primary source and record the provenance; a derivation states its formula and inputs.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: VIAGGIATORI O PIAZZISTI (art. 21; protocollo aggiuntivo, TU 2019-2023 p. 63-64): V.P. of 1st and 2nd class are classified at level 2 and level 3 and take their minimi, contingenza, IAR, EDR and scatti (renewal 2024 p. 49: same parameters 165 and 130). Not modelled: the average of the commissions of the previous 12 months in the 13th month and the ferie, the 14th month computed on minimo, contingenza and scatti only, the 6.50% cash-handling allowance (12 months) and the diaria, 50% of which is pay.
requirements.remediation: Model the commissions of a viaggiatore o piazzista and the protocol's 13th, 14th, cash-handling and diaria rules.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
